title: Reserve the Briland 30A Carriage House | Rosemary Beach Cottage Rentals | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Briland Carriage House offers easy access to the beach, luxurious amenities, and a spacious interior! Book your reservation with us today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

The Briland Carriage House is a vacation rental in the beautiful Rosemary Beach® community. It's the perfect place to relax and get away from it all for a small family or a couple.

Briland Carriage House is equipped with a full kitchen. A nook dining area looks out a wall of windows for a cheery breakfast nook, and there is also an outdoor eating space on the upper floor deck. The living room is open and bright, with a spiral staircase going to the next floor. When you're not having fun on the beach, watch your favorite shows on the large flat-screen TV on satellite or cable.

Street parking only.

Two adult-sized bikes are provided for your enjoyment. You can hop on and tour Rosemary Beach , ride the neighborhoods, or go down to the Gulf of Mexico and watch the sunset. If you go to town, be sure and get to one of the many excellent restaurants and cafes.

This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
